# CLI reference

Every `fb` command and its options, as printed by `--help`.

## `fb`

```text
Usage: fb [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  FreshBooks CLI tools for time entries and invoices.

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  alias       Name a project + service so 'fb time add' can use it.
  auth        Authentication commands.
  cache       Cached lookups (projects, services, team, clients, rates); refreshed...
  expenses    Expense commands.
  invoices    Invoice commands.
  mcp         Run as an MCP server over stdio, for Claude, Codex and other LLM...
  projects    Project commands.
  rates-init  Generate a rates.yaml template with all team members.
  reports     Financial reporting commands.
  team        List team members and contractors.
  time        Time entry commands.
```

## `fb alias`

```text
Usage: fb alias [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Name a project + service so 'fb time add' can use it.

  Workflow:
    1. fb projects list            (find the project and service ids)
    2. fb alias set acme-dev -p 1001001 -s 2002002 --default
    3. fb time add -h 2            (uses the default alias)
       fb time add -h 1 -p acme-dev -n "standup"

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  default  Make an existing alias the default for 'fb time add'.
  list     List aliases.
  rm       Remove an alias.
  set      Create or replace an alias.
```

## `fb alias default`

```text
Usage: fb alias default [OPTIONS] NAME

  Make an existing alias the default for 'fb time add'.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `fb alias set`

```text
Usage: fb alias set [OPTIONS] NAME

  Create or replace an alias.

Options:
  -p, --project TEXT  Project id or name fragment  [required]
  -s, --service TEXT  Service id or name fragment (optional)
  --default           Also make this the default alias
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

## `fb expenses list`

```text
Usage: fb expenses list [OPTIONS]

  List expenses with optional filters.

Options:
  --start-date TEXT               Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --end-date TEXT                 End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --category TEXT                 Filter by category name (partial match)
  --vendor TEXT                   Filter by vendor name (partial match)
  --status [internal|outstanding|invoiced|recouped]
                                  Filter by status
  -l, --limit INTEGER             Maximum number to show
  --json                          Output as JSON
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

## `fb time`

```text
Usage: fb time [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Time entry commands.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  add       Add a new time entry.
  export    Export time entries to CSV.
  habits    Your projects and the services you usually log to them (most-used first).
  list      List time entries with optional filters.
  summary   Show time entry summary for a month.
  unbilled  Show unbilled billable time entries.
```

## `fb time add`

```text
Usage: fb time add [OPTIONS]

  Add a new time entry.

Options:
  -h, --hours FLOAT            Hours worked  [required]
  -d, --date TEXT              Date (YYYY-MM-DD), defaults to today
  -p, --project TEXT           Alias, project id, or name fragment (default: the default
                               alias)
  -s, --service TEXT           Service id or name fragment (overrides the alias's
                               service)
  -n, --note TEXT              Note/comment
  --billable / --not-billable  Mark as billable
  --help                       Show this message and exit.
```

## `fb time export`

```text
Usage: fb time export [OPTIONS]

  Export time entries to CSV.

Options:
  -m, --month TEXT    Month to export (YYYY-MM, or MM for this year)  [required]
  -f, --format [csv]  Export format
  -o, --output TEXT   Output file (default: stdout)
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

## `fb time habits`

```text
Usage: fb time habits [OPTIONS]

  Your projects and the services you usually log to them (most-used first).

Options:
  --days INTEGER  How far back to look  [default: 90]
  --json          Output as JSON
  --help          Show this message and exit.
```

## `fb time list`

```text
Usage: fb time list [OPTIONS]

  List time entries with optional filters.

Options:
  -t, --teammate TEXT  Filter by teammate name (partial match)
  -m, --month TEXT     Filter by month (YYYY-MM, or MM for this year)
  --billable / --all   Show only billable entries (default) or all
  --show-notes         Show entry notes
  --no-rates           Hide rate columns
  --json               Output as JSON
  --help               Show this message and exit.
```

## `fb time summary`

```text
Usage: fb time summary [OPTIONS]

  Show time entry summary for a month.

Options:
  -m, --month TEXT  Month to summarize (YYYY-MM, or MM for this year)  [required]
  --by-teammate     Group by teammate
  --by-client       Group by client
  --json            Output as JSON
  --help            Show this message and exit.
```

## `fb time unbilled`

```text
Usage: fb time unbilled [OPTIONS]

  Show unbilled billable time entries.

Options:
  --by-client    Group by client
  --by-project   Group by project
  --by-teammate  Group by teammate
  --before TEXT  Only entries before date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --after TEXT   Only entries after date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --json         Output as JSON
  --help         Show this message and exit.
```
